_comment: Rocket profiles for closed-loop simulation testing.
_motor_format: X##-D  X=impulse class  ##=average thrust (N)  D=ejection delay (s)
_sources: Motor data: thrustcurve.org (Estes A8, B6, C6, D12, E12)
Rocket kits: Estes product line, AeroTech Arreaux, Public Missiles Ltd

rockets.name: Estes Alpha III on A8-3
rockets._note: 18mm beginner sport rocket with altimeter payload. ~60-80m typical.

rockets.name: Estes Big Bertha on C6-5
rockets._note: Fat 29mm sport rocket. Wide body increases drag, moderate altitude. ~150-200m.

rockets.name: Estes Pro Series II Ventris on D12-5
rockets._note: 29mm mid-power rocket. D12 in 140g airframe gives 350-500m flight.

rockets.name: AeroTech Arreaux on H73-8
rockets._note: Level 1 certification rocket. H73 in 480g 38mm airframe. 700-1200m expected.
